notes: Round 3 confirmed that the Mobius table was the bottleneck: the same 3n region with |coef| <= 12 doubled its patterns (7 -> 14), giving 8 new ones in total, and the control stayed at zero (1 raw coincidence, rejected by the deep check). My linear-b family was refused by the size cap (692k > 400k). Round 4 pushes the 3n pattern further with the big table, retries linear b at a legal size, and opens a1 = 1.

families.name: r4 3n-type, b2 = -2, very wide, Mobius <= 12
families.rationale: All 3n hits have b2 = -2; widen a0 to +-20 and b0, b1 to +-25 at that b2.

families.name: r4 linear b (legal size)
families.rationale: b(n) linear converges very fast and is still unexplored; a1 1..4, a0 +-10, b +-25.

families.name: r4 a1 = 1, Mobius <= 12
families.rationale: a(n) = n + i has not produced hits at small sizes; with the larger table and b2 in -1..2 it might.
